prescriptions.instructions: Once the ankle is less painful, sit with the foot supported and gently move it up and down or trace the alphabet. Start with a small comfortable amount and build gradually. Keep within a comfortable range; do not force movement.
stop_when: Stop if pain prevents comfortable movement or symptoms worsen.
Seek help for severe or worsening pain, swelling or inability to use the area.

prescriptions.instructions: When standing and weight bearing are comfortable, practise balancing on the affected leg on firm ground, close to a stable counter for support. Start with a short comfortable attempt and build gradually. Keep support available; do not use a cushion or close your eyes.
stop_when: Stop if pain prevents comfortable movement or symptoms worsen.
Seek help for severe or worsening pain, swelling or inability to use the area.

prescriptions.instructions: When weight bearing and gentle calf movement are comfortable, use a stable support and practise controlled heel lowering as shown in the linked ankle rehabilitation guidance. Work at your own pace, up to 2 sets on alternate days. The source gives no repetition target; stop before symptoms worsen.
stop_when: Stop if pain prevents comfortable movement or symptoms worsen.
Seek help for severe or worsening pain, swelling or inability to use the area.

activated_checkpoint.description: Eligibility for the seated no-added-resistance lateral-sprain starter, not a function assessment or medical verification.
activated_checkpoint.required_input: Current episode loading permission and one clinician-described sprain type answer in existing injury details.

new_drill.name: Seated controlled ankle heel raises
new_drill.notes: Sit on a stable chair with both feet flat on the floor. Keeping the front of both feet on the floor, slowly raise both heels within a comfortable range and slowly lower them to the floor. Stay seated; no weights, band, pressure on the knees, step, forced range or automatic increase. Follow clinician restrictions. Stop if pain or symptoms worsen during or after the work.
regress_when: Symptoms worsen: stop loading and follow conservative guidance.
stop_when: Stop for pain or worsening during or delayed symptoms. Follow clinician restrictions.
target_tissues: calf muscle-tendon unit acting at ankle
new_drill.evidence_notes: OUH NHS ankle-sprain guidance supports seated heel raises with feet flat and slow lowering. Bexley NHS ankle-sprain guidance provides 10 repetitions in a comfortable range. One set, maximum once daily, no added resistance and mild clinician-described uncomplicated lateral presentation are conservative product limits, not validated LOAD thresholds or injury grades. This seated strengthening option does not certify standing weight-bearing tolerance, ROM, strength, stability or sport readiness. Existing RESTORE includes standing tasks; LOAD here is a bounded permission stage, not a claim this movement imposes greater force than every RESTORE task. Sources: https://www.jospt.org/doi/10.2519/jospt.2021.0302, https://www.ouh.nhs.uk/media/i0ldiecy/116454sprain.pdf, https://msk-bexley.nhs.uk/conditions/foot-and-ankle-pain/ankle-sprain, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8824326/
